Shaped iteration 0096 around the three concrete defects in [independent review #485](reports/485.json).
The reviewer found contradictory baseline metadata and two synthetic false acceptances: version drift and missing key binding.
Inspection of the linked checker and input pins supports this bounded correction scope; this session ran no commands.

Wrote [tasks.json](tasks.json) with one benchmark task, default model/high effort, 90 minutes and 55 turns.
The task corrects S1–S3, preserves protected inputs, adds rejecting controls and refreshes verification evidence.
It exports reports #481/#485 and requires before/after reproduction of both independent counterexamples.
Only benchmark/writing/ may change; native execution, readiness and owner method acceptance remain unestablished.
No session can run LabVIEW.

Updated [working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) with review findings, pinned snapshots, deferred threads and resume instructions.
Read tasks.json back once and checked its structure, allowed role/options, empty dependencies and plain Python verification command by inspection.
Startup diagnostics were ok, with an estimated 12,320 tokens.

## What next
Run the correction task, then independently review its exact resulting commit/tree and evidence in a separate session.
Avoid repeating the unchanged review, POC investigation or global gap inventory; product implementation remains deferred.
